question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Mild
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mild"** means not severe, serious, or harsh; gentle in nature or behavior. (हल्का, सौम्य)

 
 
• **Example:** He had a** mild** manner and rarely got angry.
 
 
 
• **"Gentle"** refers to having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament or character. (कोमल)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a **gentle **voice that soothes everyone around her.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Mild'** is **'Gentle'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scathing** (तीव्र): Witheringly scornful; severely critical.

 
 
• **Example:** The critic gave a **scathing** review of the film.
 
 
 
• **Brittle** (भंगुर): Hard but liable to break or shatter easily.
 
 
• **Example:** The** brittle **glass shattered into pieces.
 
 
 
• **Severe** (कठोर): Very great; intense; harsh.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm caused **severe** damage to the town.
